text:
maria (AE): Quick heads-up — running into a data residency hard requirement on a POC with NordicBank. They want customer tenant traffic to stay in the EU and require an ops runbook for routing failover before the exec sign-off. Any immediate blocker we should flag to Sales?

raj (SE): We can do tenant-level region pinning on hosted, but need to confirm sub-processor list for the specific EU regions. Also need to know whether they require BYOK KMS in the region.

oliver (Infra): short answer: region pinning + control-plane in EU is doable for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted API we can offer tenant affinity to eu-west-1/eu-north-1 but control plane metadata might cross regions unless we provision EU-only control plane (ent contract).

maria (AE): They explicitly said "no metadata leaves EU" and want a documented failover that keeps inference within EU. Is that a Private-only ask? :worried: 

raj (SE): Could be two flavors: 1) Private with customer-managed control plane (easy to guarantee), 2) Hosted with EU-only dataplane + contractual subprocessor constraints — still need legal sign-off. For fallback, we can implement same-region failover to warm standby in eu-north-1. That keeps traffic in EU.

oliver (Infra): Operational notes for runbook (high-level):
```
- Normal: route -> eu-west-1 pool (tenant_pin)
- If pool saturated: warm standby eu-north-1 with same model version
- If region outage: reject new requests with 503 + guidance header
- Audit: log egress path, KMS key id (EU-only) to audit bucket
```

ops-bot: Deploy check: eu-west-1 pool capacity 72% utilized; eu-north-1 standby has 12 reserved GPUs.

sophie (Legal): We need to provide the sub-processor registry scoped to EU regions (list + certs). Also FYI: DPA amendment required for any EU-only control plane commit.

maria (AE): Can you list the exact sub-processors used for model serving in eu-west-1 and eu-north-1? They asked for contact names for SOC docs.

oliver (Infra): sub-processors (short): cloud-hosting-provider-eu, object-storage-eu, monitoring-provider, kms-provider-eu. I’ll pull the cert pack but flag: some monitoring telemetry sent to our multiregion backend by default unless we enable EU-only telemetry mode.

raj (SE): Config snippet we propose to share with the customer (they asked for an ops-friendly runnable example):
```
route_policy:
  tenant_pin: eu-west-1
  failover:
    - eu-north-1
  reject_on_cross_border: true
kms:
  key_scope: eu-only
```

maria (AE): perfect. Can we attach estimated pricing delta for EU-only standby capacity? They'll ask.

oliver (Infra): estimate: +18% on baseline hosted cost for reserved standby capacity (warm replicas), +additional licensing if they require EU-only control-plane (~one-time onboarding fee).

sophie (Legal): also include SLA language about inability to guarantee 100% isolation in hosted mode unless we run an EU-only control plane — we need to offer Private for absolute guarantee.

maria (AE): OK — action items: raj to draft ops runbook and sample config, oliver to attach sub-processor certs and cost delta, sophie to draft DPA note. I'll consolidate into a one-page POC appendix for the customer. Timeline: need first draft by EOD Fri.

raj (SE): on it. Will ping once runbook draft is ready :+1:

oliver (Infra): I’ll pull certs and capacity worksheet, ETA Thu morning.

sophie (Legal): will draft DPA note and list of required contract changes, ETA Thu afternoon.

maria (AE): thanks all — looping in customer on Friday with the appendix. :raised_hands:
